message: blog: Mastering Behavioral Interview Questions: Your AI-Powered Edge
post:
This past week has been a whirlwind of building out the core experience and expanding our content creation capabilities. We've been refining how our system handles security, consolidating responsibilities within the proxy handler to ensure a cleaner, more efficient process for generating content security policies and nonces. Simultaneously, we're improving the underlying AI models, implementing a cooldown period for models that encounter quota issues and upgrading their capabilities for higher token limits, which directly impacts the quality and depth of the content they can produce.

On the user-facing side, we've been polishing the interview experience. This includes enhancing UI layouts, adjusting the AI orb's camera position for better interaction, and ensuring interviewer identity is enforced. We've also added session duration tracking to better understand user engagement.

Perhaps most excitingly, we've significantly advanced our automated content generation. This involves a new workflow for creating blog posts, leveraging Gemini and GitHub Actions. We've seen this evolve from initial drafts on topics like the STAR method to more practical guides, including a recent post on ATS resume tips and a follow-up email guide, all aimed at giving users a real edge in their job search.

How do you see AI impacting the way we create and consume content in the coming years?
